title: Enhancing Medical Lesion Segmentation via Several Simple Modules
abstract: arXiv:2610.41652v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This work introduces three lightweight enhancement modules for medical lesion segmentation to improve clinical applicability, particularly under data-scarce and computationally constrained environments. Current mainstream methods struggle with the lack of high-quality annotations for rare pathologies, which often leads to severe morphological distortions during inference, despite achieving seemingly ideal DSC scores. Furthermore, the isolated development of individual segmentation tasks restricts cross-domain methodological innovation, underscoring the need for leveraging shared knowledge across different lesions within the same anatomical region. However, constrained access to historical data and annotations hinders efficient knowledge extraction and triggers catastrophic forgetting when adapting to new classes. translated_title: 通过若干简单模块增强医学病灶分割
translated_abstract: 这项工作为医学病灶分割引入了三个轻量级增强模块，以提升临床适用性，尤其是在数据稀缺和计算资源受限的环境中。当前主流方法难以应对罕见病理高质量标注缺失的问题，这常常导致在推理过程中出现严重的形态畸变，尽管其DSC（Dice相似系数）分数看似理想。此外，各个分割任务的孤立发展限制了跨领域的方法创新，凸显了在同一解剖区域内利用不同病灶间共享知识的必要性。然而，历史数据和标注的获取受限阻碍了高效的知识提取，并在适应新类别时引发灾难性遗忘。为应对这些挑战，我们首先提出了结合连续空间池化的DT-Morph组合损失，以优化不同……
tldr: 该论文提出三个轻量级增强模块（包括带连续空间池化的DT-Morph组合损失），以在数据稀缺和计算受限的环境下提升医学病灶分割的临床适用性，解决罕见病理标注缺失导致的形态畸变以及跨病灶知识共享中的灾难性遗忘问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces three lightweight enhancement modules, including a DT-Morph Combined Loss with continuous spatial pooling, to improve the clinical applicability of medical lesion segmentation under data-scarce and computationally constrained environments.
